We need answer JSON only. Need solve plan. Need analyze task.

We have Sheet1:
A1 Keyword, B1 Search Volume
A2 gardening B2 10
A3 garden tools B3 20
A4 gardening tool set B4 30
A5 gardening tools B5 40
A6 garden tool B6 50
D1 Roots, E1 Broad Search Volume
D2 gardening
D3 garden
D4 tool
D5 tools
Need E2:E5 sum of values in B where root word in D exactly matched as complete word within keywords A2:A6. "Match each root word as a complete word within the keywords(D2-D5) to all in column A (A2-A6) and adding the search volume (in column B, i.e. B2-B6)." So for each D, sum B where A contains D as whole word. Need formula.

Need Excel-compatible classic functions. Need complete word matching. Could use SUMPRODUCT with ISNUMBER(SEARCH) but SEARCH matches substring, not complete word. Need whole word. Options:
- Use SUMPRODUCT with FIND and word boundaries: =SUMPRODUCT((ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" "&D2&" ", " "&A2:A6&" "))*B2:B6))
This treats complete word if surrounded by spaces. But if keyword has punctuation? Data simple. This is array formula? SUMPRODUCT handles arrays without CSE. Formula: =SUMPRODUCT(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" "&D2&" ", " "&A2:A6&" "))*B2:B6). Need ensure D2 relative, A2:A6 absolute? If fill E2:E5, D2 relative, A2:A6 absolute? If fill down, A2:A6 should remain A2:A6, so use $A$2:$A$6. D2 relative. Formula top-left E2: =SUMPRODUCT(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" "&D2&" ", " "&$A$2:$A$6&" "))*$B$2:$B$6). Fill E2:E5.

Check:
D2 gardening: A2 gardening -> " gardening " in " gardening " yes 10; A4 gardening tool set -> " gardening tool set " contains " gardening " yes 30; A5 gardening tools -> 40; total 80.
D3 garden: A3 garden tools -> 20; A6 garden tool -> 50; total 70. Does "gardening" contain "garden"? With spaces: " gardening " contains " garden "? no because " gardening " has "garden" followed by i not space. Good.
D4 tool: A3 garden tools contains " tool "? " garden tools " has " tools " not " tool " because tool followed s. A4 gardening tool set contains " tool " yes 30; A6 garden tool contains " tool " yes 50; total 80. Does "tools" match tool? no.
D5 tools: A3 garden tools 20; A5 gardening tools 40; total 60. Good.

Need output JSON with route operations, summary, operations. Use fill_formula range E2:E5 formula top-left. Ensure formula string begins =. Use double quotes inside JSON escaped. Formula: =SUMPRODUCT(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" "&D2&" "," "&$A$2:$A$6&" "))*$B$2:$B$6)
Need maybe SEARCH returns #VALUE if not found? ISNUMBER handles. Multiplication with B range. If B has numbers. Good.

Could also use SUMIFS with wildcards? Complete word tricky. SUMPRODUCT is fine.

Need only JSON no markdown. Ensure valid. max operations 1. summary short.
</think>
